questions: What is a blank?
If the blank gives a signal, does that mean something is there?
What is precision?
If the precision is excellent, is the result necessarily correct?
What is sensitivity?
If sensitivity goes up, will every small change be noticed?
What is a detector?
If the detector stays silent, is there definitely nothing there?
What is selectivity?
If the selectivity is high, does it ignore everything else?
What is a peak?
When the peak moves, has the thing itself moved?
What is a fingerprint?
If two fingerprints look alike, do they have to come from the same source?
What is recovery?
After recovery, is everything back to where it was?
What is the range?
If the range gets wider, is it automatically better?
What is drift?
If the drift stops, is everything back where it started?
What is a spike?
If the spike is larger, does that mean the sample started with more?
What is a library?
If the library gives a match, is the identity settled?
What is a standard?
If the standard is met, is every result correct?
What is interference?
If the interference stops, is the result automatically right?
What is a method?
If the method gives the same answer twice, is it proven reliable?
